text:
sam: Heads up - canary for release v3.4.0 (10% US-WEST) started ~5m ago. p95 jumped from 240ms -> 1.2s, errors +0.6%. Thinking we need rollback criteria check and who runs it. :eyes:
jess: yikes. do we have an automated threshold for this canary or is manual-only for this change window?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout: v3.4.0 -> 10% US-WEST. Metrics snapshot: p95=1203ms, p50=140ms, error_rate=0.6%. Auto-rollback rule NOT triggered (manual-override: true). See /deploybot status for details.
sam: manual-override was set because of dedicated schema bump. we left auto-rollback off. need a quick decision: manual rollback to v3.3.9, or keep observing for +10m?
mike: i'm on it if we decide to roll back. prefer rolling back if p95 stays >700ms at +10m or errors >0.5% sustained. that was our preflight guardrail.
jess: agreed. product_lead, FYI - this may affect customer-facing latency on embeddings. we should prep a short note if we roll back. @ana can you draft a one-paragraph?
product_lead: Ack. If rollback, include: what changed, expected impact, ETA for safe re-deploy, and whether we need to pin dedicated customers.
deploy-bot: Canary timers: 5m elapsed. Next evaluation at +10m from root ts. Current flag: manual-override=true. Rollback command available to ops: ```bash
# rollback to previous stable
redwoodctl deploy rollback --release v3.3.9 --scope canary --region us-west
# pin to stable until investigation complete
redwoodctl pin version --service inference-api --version v3.3.9 --reason "canary latency regression"
```
mike: i'll run the rollback if we greenlight. plan: 1) run deploy rollback, 2) pin, 3) sanity smoke (10 sample requests), 4) post short comms and close thread. anyone object?
ana: (support) we should also prepare customer success blurb in case a major customer pings. will have a one-liner ready in 5m.
sam: decision: hold 5 more minutes to watch trend, if p95 > 700ms at that point we rollback. jack (oncall) - make sure we have logs collected for the release and create a ticket with traces.
jess: +1. also capture KV cache metrics and GPU queue lengths - those were flagged during perf bench.
deploy-bot: Alert: p95 still high at +9m (p95=980ms, error_rate=0.55%). Recommend manual rollback per team policy.
sam: okay executing rollback now. @mike please go ahead. :thumbsup:
mike: executing rollback command now.
# Output truncated: rollback started at 1728003578, rollout to 100% previous stable underway.
mike: rollback completed for canary -> v3.3.9. pin applied. smoke tests: p95=210ms, error_rate=0.02% (samples ok).
ana: CS blurb ready: "We observed a transient performance regression in a new canary release; we rolled back to the previously stable version to ensure latency stability while we investigate. No customer actions needed."
product_lead: sending to support and legal. thanks.
sam: filing postmortem ticket and tagging eng-ml for kernel/quantization regression investigation. assign to @jess. closing thread after ticket created.
jess: noted, will pick it up. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
